name: PageHush — Persistent Element Hider
description: Permanently hide annoying page elements (banners, popups, sidebars) per-site with a visual point-and-click picker.

_permission_justifications.activeTab: Grants temporary access to the current tab when the user clicks the extension icon, enabling the element picker to be injected without requiring broad host permissions upfront.
_permission_justifications.storage: Stores hiding rules (CSS selectors per site), user preferences, and payment status cache locally. No data is sent to external servers.
_permission_justifications.scripting: Injects the element picker script on-demand and registers persistent content scripts to apply hiding rules on sites the user has configured.
_permission_justifications.optional_host_permissions (<all_urls>): Requested per-site only when the user creates their first hiding rule for a domain. Required so the hider content script can run automatically on page load for configured sites.
